command:
set -eu
cfg=/etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/00-local-key-only.conf

printf '%s\n' '# Managed locally: require SSH public-key authentication' 'PubkeyAuthentication yes' 'PasswordAuthentication no' 'KbdInteractiveAuthentication no' 'AuthenticationMethods publickey' > "$cfg"

command:
set -eu
work=$(mktemp -d /tmp/opsadmin-ssh-test.XXXXXX)
cleanup() {
  if [ -f "$work/authorized_keys.original" ]; then
    cp -p "$work/authorized_keys.original" /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys
    chown opsadmin:opsadmin /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys
    chmod 0600 /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys
    restorecon /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  fi
  rm -f "$work/test_rsa" "$work/test_rsa.pub" "$work/ssh.log" "$work/ssh.out" "$work/authorized_keys.original" "$work/known_hosts"
  rmdir "$work" 2>/dev/null || true
}
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM
cp -p /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys "$work/authorized_keys.original"
ssh-keygen -q -t rsa -b 2048 -N '' -C temporary-behavior-test -f "$work/test_rsa"
cat "$work/test_rsa.pub" >> /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys
chown opsadmin:opsadmin /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys
chmod 0600 /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys
restorecon /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys
ssh -vv -o BatchMode=yes -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o UserKnownHostsFile="$work/known_hosts" -i "$work/test_rsa" opsadmin@"$NODE_IP" 'printf "remote-user="; id -un; printf "remote-uid="; id -u; printf "remote-groups="; id -Gn' >"$work/ssh.out" 2>"$work/ssh.log"
grep -E 'Authenticated to .* using "publickey"' "$work/ssh.log"
cat "$work/ssh.out"
printf '%s\n' 'temporary-test-key-will-now-be-removed'

set -eu
work=$(mktemp -d /tmp/opsadmin-post-restart-test.XXXXXX)
cleanup() {
  if [ -f "$work/authorized_keys.original" ]; then
    cp -p "$work/authorized_keys.original" /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys
    chown opsadmin:opsadmin /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys
    chmod 0600 /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys
    restorecon /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  fi
  rm -f "$work/test_rsa" "$work/test_rsa.pub" "$work/key.log" "$work/key.out" "$work/deny.log" "$work/authorized_keys.original" "$work/known_hosts"
  rmdir "$work" 2>/dev/null || true
}
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM
cp -p /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys "$work/authorized_keys.original"
ssh-keygen -q -t rsa -b 2048 -N '' -C temporary-post-restart-test -f "$work/test_rsa"
cat "$work/test_rsa.pub" >> /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys
chown opsadmin:opsadmin /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys
chmod 0600 /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys
restorecon /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys
ssh -vv -o BatchMode=yes -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o UserKnownHostsFile="$work/known_hosts" -i "$work/test_rsa" opsadmin@"$NODE_IP" 'printf "remote-user="; id -un; printf "remote-uid="; id -u' >"$work/key.out" 2>"$work/key.log"
grep -E 'Authenticated to .* using "publickey"' "$work/key.log"
cat "$work/key.out"
set +e
